text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Audit Committee and City Council with the 2024 audited financial statements of Community Centres. The 2024 audited financial statements for the ten Community Centres are presented to Audit Committee after approval by their respective Boards of Management. At this time, the audits of nine Community Centres have been completed, and one was still in progress. Depending on when the remaining audit is completed, the Independent Auditor's Report, accompanying financial statements and management control letter (where applicable) of that Community Centre will be presented at a subsequent meeting of the Audit Committee.
